## About

Kelly Bergman is a licensed mortgage loan officer serving homebuyers in the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex, Tyler, Rockwall, Heath, Forney, and East Texas areas. She specializes in helping first-time homebuyers, veterans, and families find the right mortgage solutions.

## Services

- Conventional Loans
- FHA Loans
- VA Loans (for veterans and active military)
- Down Payment Assistance Programs
- Refinancing
- First-Time Homebuyer Programs
